# Howard Construction Inc.

> Family-owned, licensed Class B general contractor (CSLB Lic. #836369) headquartered in Santa Rosa, CA, serving Napa Valley, Sonoma Valley, and the greater North Bay since 2000. Founder Philip Howard personally oversees every project. Phone: (707) 578-6565. Email: info@howardconstructioninc.com. Address: 4012 Cervantes Rd, Santa Rosa, CA 95403.

Services: home remodels (kitchens, bathrooms, whole-home), home additions, ADU construction and garage conversions, pool & outdoor living construction, decks & pergolas, garages & carriage houses, and fire-hardened / WUI Chapter 7A compliant construction including wildfire rebuilds (Tubbs, Nuns, Glass Fire areas).

Service area: Napa, Yountville, St. Helena, Calistoga, American Canyon, Angwin, Deer Park, Oakville, Rutherford, Pope Valley, Sonoma, Glen Ellen, Kenwood, Santa Rosa, Petaluma, Healdsburg, Windsor, Fairfield, Vacaville, Vallejo, San Francisco, and Marin County.
